winning_goal.detail: Pedro Porro crossed, Nico Williams headed the ball back across goal, Torres finished from close range.

key_events: Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) sent off for a second yellow card in second-half stoppage time of regulation (foul on Pau Cubarsi) -- Argentina played the last ~30 minutes, including all of extra time, a man down.
Emiliano Martinez (Argentina GK) set a World Cup final record with 11 saves despite the loss.
Final shot count: Spain 20 (12 on target) vs Argentina 2 (0 on target).
Argentina held roughly 35% possession through 90 minutes.
significance: Spain's second men's World Cup title (also 2010, also won 1-0 in extra time). Denies Argentina back-to-back titles -- would have been the first repeat champion since Brazil 1958/1962.
